params.q: What is the normal blood sugar level 2 hours after a meal in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the normal blood sugar level 2 hours after a meal in India?

response.header: For non-diabetic adults in India, a normal blood sugar level two hours after a meal is generally below 140 mg/dL, while readings between 140–199 mg/dL indicate impaired glucose tolerance (prediabetes), and 200 mg/dL or above suggest diabetes. +2

text_blocks.snippet: Postprandial blood sugar, often measured 2 hours after starting a meal, reflects how effectively your body manages glucose from food. After a standard Indian meal containing rice, roti, or other carbohydrates:

Blood sugar typically peaks around 45–60 minutes after eating and should ideally return toward fasting levels (below 110 mg/dL) within 2–3 hours for healthy adults . Indian diets, which often include high glycemic index foods like white rice or refined wheat, can lead to higher post-meal spikes, making monitoring important Lupin Diagnostics .

list.snippet: Adults aged 20–59 years: Post-meal target <140 mg/dL
Seniors (60+ years): Slightly higher post-meal readings may be observed, often acceptable below 180 mg/dL due to physiological changes 1 .
Pregnancy: Post 2-hour glucose should ideally stay under 120–153 mg/dL depending on gestational testing protocols 1 .
Walk for 10–15 minutes after a meal to help lower post-meal blood sugar.
Prefer whole grains, high-fiber foods, and balanced meals to slow glucose absorption.
Regular monitoring is recommended, especially for individuals with risk factors like family history, sedentary lifestyle, or central obesity 2 .

text_blocks.snippet: Summary: Maintaining a 2-hour post-meal blood sugar below 140 mg/dL is considered healthy for Indian adults, while values above this threshold should prompt lifestyle evaluation or medical consultation to prevent progression to diabetes +1 .

references.title: Blood Sugar Chart for Indians: Age-wise Normal & Danger Levels
references.snippet: A reading of 150 mg/dL two hours after a meal falls in the prediabetic range (140–199 mg/dL). It is worth discussing this with your doctor for further evaluation.

references.snippet: After a standard Indian meal containing rice or roti, blood sugar in a non-diabetic adult should peak below 140 to 150 mg/dL (usually between 45 to 60 minutes after eating) and return to fasting baseline below 110 mg/dL within 2 to 3 hours.

references.title: PP Blood Sugar Normal Range (2 Hours After Meal) | ExaHealth
references.snippet: A normal post-prandial (PP) blood sugar is under 140 mg/dL two hours after a meal. Learn the full mg/dL bands and how PP differs from fasting glucose and HbA1c. Knowing the pp blood sugar normal range is crucial for tracking how your body processes glucose after a meal.

references.title: Blood Sugar Levels After Meals – What’s Normal and What’s Not
references.snippet: Post-meal blood sugar (postprandial glucose) measures how your body handles sugar after eating, typically checked 1–2 hours after a meal. For most healthy individuals, normal levels remain below 140 mg/dL.

references.title: Blood Sugar After Meal What’s Normal & When It’s Dangerous
references.snippet: A normal sugar level after a meal for a nondiabetic patient should be 140 mg/dL, and this must be at least 2 hours after the meal. Diabetes occurs when 2-hour postprandial glucose consistently exceeds 200 mg/dL.

references.title: Normal Blood Sugar Levels Chart (India) | BBDO
references.snippet: Normal fasting glucose is 70–99 mg/dL and 2-hour post-meal under 140 mg/dL. See the complete chart for normal, prediabetic and diabetic ranges, plus HbA1c equivalents.

references.title: Blood Sugar Normal Range: Fasting, PP & HbA1c Explained
references.snippet: A post-meal (2-hour) blood sugar below 140 mg/dL is considered normal. Between 140–199 mg/dL suggests pre-diabetes, and 200 mg/dL or above is in the diabetic range.

references.title: Normal Blood Sugar Levels in India — Fasting, PP, HbA1c Explained
references.snippet: Normal blood sugar levels in India: fasting, post‑meal (PP), random, and HbA1c ranges. Understand prediabetes cutoffs, symptoms, and safe next steps.

references.title: Blood Sugar Chart — Normal Fasting, PP & HbA1c Levels
references.snippet: Fasting blood sugar is measured after 8+ hours without food (usually morning). Post-prandial (PP) is measured 2 hours after eating. Both are important - fasting shows baseline, PP shows how your body handles glucose.

references.title: Blood Sugar Level Chart: Normal, Prediabetes and Diabetes
references.snippet: A clear sugar level chart for fasting, post-meal and HbA1c, with what counts as normal, prediabetes and diabetes. Explained by an MD physician in Sonipat.

references.title: Normal Blood Sugar Range: Everything You Need to Know
references.snippet: For people with diabetes mellitus, blood sugar levels should stay between 70 to 130 mg/dL before meals and remain under 180 mg/dL after eating. These post-meal sugar levels usually peak within an hour of eating and should return to normal within two hours.
